requirement_vague: Updating a todo correctly changes its fields
requirement_precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'Original Todo'. The todo should have isComplete=false. Call PUT /todos/{id} with isComplete=true and title 'Updated Todo'. Verify response is 200 OK. Then call GET /todos/{id} and verify isComplete is now true and title is 'Updated Todo'.

implementation.location: create_todo, update_todo, get_todo routes (/todos POST, /todos/{id} PUT, /todos/{id} GET)
implementation.code_reference:
todo = Todo(title=todo_in.title, isComplete=todo_in.isComplete, user_id=current_user.id)
...
todo.title = todo_in.title
todo.isComplete = todo_in.isComplete
implementation.reasoning: The POST /todos endpoint creates a todo with the provided title and default isComplete=false when omitted. The PUT /todos/{id} endpoint updates both title and isComplete for the authenticated user's todo, commits the changes, and GET /todos/{id} reads back the persisted updated values; FastAPI returns 200 OK by default for successful GET/POST/PUT handlers.
